outcome: neonatal outcomes (LGA neonates, macrosomia, neonatal hypoglycemia)
cohort: Women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) after the first trimester, attending tertiary care hospitals.
finding: Women with GDM treated with insulin had a higher baseline risk profile and experienced higher rates of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, as well as a more rapid progression to postpartum diabetes, compared to those not on insulin.
mod_finding: The need for caesarean section was higher in GDM women treated with insulin.
